cat << 'EOF' > solution.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if a number is prime
is_prime() {
    local n=$1
    if [ "$n" -lt 2 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [ "$n" -eq 2 ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ $((n % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local i=3
    while [ $((i * i)) -le "$n" ]; do
        if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then
            return 1
        fi
        i=$((i + 2))
    done
    return 0
}

sum=0

for filepath in log_files/log_server_*.txt; do
    [ -f "$filepath" ] || continue
    filename=$(basename "$filepath")
    
    # Extract server ID and date from filename: log_server_X_YYYY-MM-DD.txt
    server_id=$(echo "$filename" | sed 's/log_server_\([0-9]*\)_.*/\1/')
    date_str=$(echo "$filename" | sed 's/log_server_[0-9]*_\(.*\)\.txt/\1/')
    
    # Check if server ID is prime
    if ! is_prime "$server_id"; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Check if the date is within the last 7 days
    file_epoch=$(date -d "$date_str" +%s)
    now_epoch=$(date +%s)
    diff_days=$(( (now_epoch - file_epoch) / 86400 ))
    
    if [ "$diff_days" -le 7 ]; then
        # Sum all integers in the file
        file_sum=$(awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}' "$filepath")
        sum=$((sum + file_sum))
    fi
done

echo "$sum"
EOF
chmod +x solution.sh
bash solution.sh
